[CARRY] The 07[1-9] regex over-accepts 075 (currently unallocated). Kept as-is (matches the skill's lightweight-validation philosophy; the skill already recommends libphonenumber for strict validation). Tighten to 07[1-46-9] only if 075 misclassification becomes an issue.

Resolved [CARRY] 075 over-acceptance: national class tightened to 07[2-46-79] from the MoC allocation dataset (data.gov.il israel-numbering-plan). The same source showed 071 and 078 have NO allocation, reversing the v1.2.0 (078) and v1.2.1 (071) additions, which came from Wikipedia/libphonenumber, not the MoC table. Lesson: for prefix allocation, the data.gov.il CKAN API is the primary source; Wikipedia and libphonenumber lag or lead it.
1-700 had been labelled premium since creation; MoC dialing plan says shared cost (local call, split charging). Premium is 1-900/1901/1902/1919.
051 holder corrected to WeCom Mobile (MoC table); 058 now listed under Cellcom.
052-1234567 (used as the canonical example everywhere) is an M2M block per the MoC table and plan (N=0-1 is M2M only). Replaced examples; enriched content must not reintroduce it.
